title: Volcanoes of Guatemala
intro: 10 volcanoes of Guatemala, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Agua
rounds.fact: Agua is a stratovolcano with a recorded summit elevation of 3,760 m in the source data. The data places it in Guatemala.
